8.name: How To Order
8.content:
1. As our goods are located worldwide, please take care when making purchases. If the goods are located in China or Hong Kong, we can typically provide live freight quotes and accept online payment. However, if you cannot check out, please email our sales team for updated details.
  2. Once you check out via our online portal, we will process your order immediately Please expect your tracking number to be emailed to you once your order has been shipped out.

Please note we do not have any payment plans or credit available. We ONLY accept full payment in advance. Please refer to our payment instructions.

I have a freight agent

If you would like your freight agent to arrange your shipment, please provide their full contact information including contact name, phone and email. We must receive your written authority before we release your equipment to them.

I am purchasing a machine or container load

For machine and container orders, we will need to work with you directly as there are strict document requirements. You will receive an official invoice and shipping documents for your approval.

Once we receive the documents approved by you, we will arrange the cargo.

My items need to be sourced or assembled

If we need to collect your machines/parts or assemble the goods, we will ask for a deposit. Depending on the size of the order, this may be 30%, 50% or full payment in advance.

Once we receive your deposit, we will collect and assemble the machines/parts to your specifications (voltage, language etc). Once finished, we will arrange the transport, send you the documents and tracking numbers.

Minimum Orders

Please note there are 2 different types of minimum order on our website:

  1. Some items have a minimum quantity amount. If you are unable to accept these quantities, please contact our team. Sometimes factories will allow for a quantity variation, however there will be a $25 - $100 USD handling fee to cover costs. This is typically refundable on your next bulk order.
  2. Some items have a minimum dollar amount. Therefore, you can order different products to reach the dollar amount. However, the total order amount must be greater than $200 USD. This does not include shipping fees.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

  • Our website is updated daily which means the prices are subject to change without prior notice. If you are looking for something no longer on our website, please contact our sales team who will be able to check the availability.
  • Please ensure to check the “product details” section of the item prior to purchasing. Failure to check language or country location is not covered within our return policy.
  • The delivery date for each item will be different for ever customer. The expected delivery date will be displayed on your proforma invoice while we confirm your order. Alternatively, you can check the “available date” section on the product.
  • The sales invoice will be provided along with proper packing documents (e.g commercial invoice, packing lists etc)
  • Any import tax/duties are the responsibility of the receiver/buyer. Please contact your local forwarder or our salesman for details.
  • UNIT PRICE DOES NOT INCLUDE SHIPING COST.
